assumptions: A single classifier's per-cell judgements, self-rated ~0.7 confidence each. The aggregate conclusion is robust to several re-assignments; individual cell assignments are not authoritative.
attrs.evidence: DEMOTED FROM MEASURED IN R5 — this is the metrology incident the Mosaic's measurement layer was looking for, and it is live rather than historical. The record carries THREE denominators for one measurement: 'all 44 cells of the v0.6 table', '34 of 45 records', over a table that today has 46 cells. It quantifies over an 'eight-kind taxonomy' that is written down nowhere in this tree — the shipped table uses six tokens (Structural, Order, Conservation, Statistical, Authority, Flow?) and there is no definition site for the other two. Two of the four kinds the statement says 'never occur alone' — Epistemic and Environmental — occur ZERO times, so the sentence is vacuously true for half its subject. And 7 of 46 cells carry a `kind` field at all, so the population the surviving numbers describe cannot be recovered from anything shipped. The underlying observation may well be right; what is certain is that no instrument, procedure or population was recorded, and MEASURED is a status about evidence, not about confidence. Re-earning it needs a measurement record and a second classifier.
attrs.gap: Only 7 of 46 cells carry a `kind` field. Classifying the rest is unfinished work, and the classification instrument does not exist as an artifact — one classifier ran once, unrecorded (ASM-SINGLE-CLASSIFIER).
attrs.review_focus: The demotion is the safe move and may be too cautious: if the eight-kind vocabulary can be located in an earlier revision and the 44/45 denominators reconciled, this goes back to MEASURED with a measurement record. Nobody has looked.
attrs.statement: The eight-kind taxonomy is neither a partition nor orthogonal: most cells need two or more kinds, and Order, Epistemic, Statistical and Environmental never occur alone.
